imageQa.note: Intentional image-free layouts. The base-layer guide uses three accurate category text links; no new or changed editorial, affiliate or product image is required.

searchConsole.signal: Four homepage impressions, zero clicks, average position 1.5, no query rows and no supported non-homepage cluster
searchConsole.decision: The sample is too small and queryless to justify a Data-led page. Today's portfolio therefore uses one authority expansion and two distinct explorations selected from inventory gaps, recent-topic rotation and reader utility.
searchConsole.ignored: The four homepage impressions, HTTP homepage variant and aggregate average position were deliberately ignored as insufficient evidence for keyword targeting, title changes or an editorial pivot.

monetization.placement: Three disclosed, sponsored/nofollow category text recommendations appear only on the base-layer guide. The used-car and housewarming guides remain commerce-free.

authority.action: Created a citation-worthy used-car purchase control file that joins seller identity, exact VIN, FTC Buyers Guide, NMVTIS history, NHTSA recall status, independent inspection, test-drive observations, financing, promises and closing evidence.
authority.cluster: Vehicle ownership and consumer-record authority, with reciprocal paths from auto-repair, insurance, roadside and complaint guides; cold-weather style and hospitality clusters gain reciprocal links as well.
authority.opportunity: One qualified accuracy opportunity was logged for the U.S. Department of Justice NMVTIS Program Office; no outreach sent.

diversity: The batch answers three unrelated questions across Life and Style: how to verify and document a used-car transaction, how to choose next-to-skin clothing by activity and label, and how to host a first gathering in a new home. Only the apparel guide is commercial. None follows the weak Search Console sample.
